subject: Confidential: Review Orbit Plan & Manager Scripts
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
Cc: Tara Singh <tara@talentpartners.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2026 08:15:00 -0800
Subject: Confidential: Review Orbit Plan & Manager Scripts

Team —

Attached is a lean take on the annual review "orbit" plan I promised: staggered manager notices, a proposed blackout window, and the first-draft manager scripts. High-level goals: reduce surprise escalations, give managers clear one-page actions, and protect privileged role handling. Please treat as CONFIDENTIAL — limited distribution.

Key asks in this email:
- Read the manager script doc and call out any phrasing that could trigger escalation (esp. compensation mentions)
- Confirm the proposed blackout window (Dec 13–20) is feasible for your teams
- Flag any org units that must be handled out-of-band (legal, finance, security-sensitive roles)

Attachments: manager_scripts_v1.docx, staged_emails_v2.md, review_orbit_timeline.xlsx

I'll compile feedback and push a manager-facing packet by EOD Friday. If you see anything we must loop Legal or Security on immediately, call it out inline.

Thanks —
Sean
Sean Gallagher
Director, People Programs
Redwood Inference

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2026 12:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Confidential: Review Orbit Plan & Manager Scripts

Sean —

Thanks for the packet. Quick reads: I like the staggered approach but want a shorter window for manager acknowledgement (48 hours vs 72). Two small notes:

- Manager script: please avoid any language that implies compensation is final — replace "will be updated" with "expected range communicated by People Ops"
- Blackout: Dec 13–20 is tight for my teams because of product freeze on Dec 15; can we shift earlier by 3 days?

Also, can we get a 30-minute calibration walk-through with managers the morning we send packets? A live Q/A reduces follow-ups. I'm free Thu 11/12 9–11am.

-Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Engineering Manager

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 09:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Confidential: Review Orbit Plan & Manager Scripts

Looping in a few technical constraints I want captured.

- Forms: the draft review form currently surfaces compensation fields. For confidentiality we should mask salary lines and only show total comp band to non-HR reviewers. Suggest: add an access-level flag in the form (HR-only vs Manager-view).
- Audit logs: Security asked that we retain manager packet delivery receipts and timestamps for 12 months — add to timeline step 3.
- Rollback: if an org-level exception is requested, we need a documented rollback path and a named approver (Priya? Marissa?).

Attachment: small markup on manager_scripts_v1.docx (inline comments).

-Aditya
Staff Site Reliability Engineer

From: Tara Singh <tara@talentpartners.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 10:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Confidential: Review Orbit Plan & Manager Scripts

Thanks for sharing — we reviewed and propose two small edits that often reduce escalation:

1) Manager script: add a "What to do if an employee pushes back" bullet with escalation steps and a template email for managers to use.
2) Staggering: we recommend grouping by manager span-size rather than org level; it preserves calibration when managers have large teams.

We can draft the escalation template and be on the calibration call. Available Thu 11/12 10–11am PT.

Best,
Tara Singh
Principal Consultant, PeopleOps Consultancy

[PeopleOps Consultancy — suggested edits attached as comments in manager_scripts_v1.docx]

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>, Tara Singh <tara@talentpartners.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 16:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Confidential: Review Orbit Plan & Manager Scripts — final sync and next steps

Appreciate the quick reviews and the helpful edits. Plan of record below (finalizing and will publish packet Friday 11/13 at 9am PT):

1) Timeline: shift blackout to Dec 10–17 to accommodate product freeze (per Lauren). Delivery to managers Friday 11/13 9am PT.
2) Manager packet: incorporate Tara's escalation template and Aditya's access-level note (HR-only for compensation lines).
3) Calibration: 11/13 10–10:30am PT quick walk-through for managers; Tara will join for Q/A.
4) Approvals & rollback: Priya is named approver for org-level exceptions; Marissa will coordinate Legal if needed.
5) Audit & retention: delivery receipts retained 12 months (Security ask).

Please acknowledge with a one-line reply if you can be on the 11/13 10am calibration slot. If no reply by EOD, I'll assume consent and proceed. Drive packet: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1ExampleReviewKit

Thanks —
Sean
[Attachment: final_manager_packet_stub.zip — contains revised scripts and timeline spreadsheet]
